coverage.statement: Public manufacturer documentation, released source code and public project posts reviewed through September 7, 2026. This is a curated, non-exhaustive comparison, not a complete market survey. Product claims, code inspection and unverified gaps are distinguished; no hardware has been bench-tested.

notice: Supplier quotes checked September 7, 2026 · ZIP 10014 · quantity 1 · USD. Known parts, partial freight and dated package offers below; no all-parts arrival or complete operational total verified.

items.name: Waveshare ePaper 1.54 V2
items.summary: Best exact e-ink + two-way audio hardware lead: 200×200 e-paper, onboard microphone, ES8311 codec, speaker, side buttons and Wi-Fi.
evidence: Require V2: 8MB flash/8MB PSRAM; V1 is 4MB/2MB and examples are not interchangeable.

Exact non-touch battery-included SKU 32298 selected on live store: $16.99 quantity one before tax/shipping. Add to Cart present; workshop quantities and fulfillment not verified. Store lists 8MB/8MB matching V2; confirm received revision.
Actual button-driven fixed-buffer record/playback example inspected. This is not hold-to-record/release-to-send or an agent client. Top-level source license unresolved.
Battery-variant description mentions case; package lists board and optional battery with Included selected. Battery capacity, assembled dimensions and measured runtime remain unverified.
items.gaps: First bench pilot, not a ready kit: implement licensed physical PTT/Hermes/TLS firmware, test battery/reconnect and confirm delivered bundle. No cellular or documented headphone jack.

image.alt: Waveshare ESP32-S3-ePaper-1.54 manufacturer dimension diagram
image.kind: Manufacturer dimension diagram — verify delivered V2

items.spec_note: Use the non-touch V2 / SKU 32298 specifications, not V1 or the touch bundle. Resource-page schematic is touch-family N8R8; exact non-touch V2 schematic applicability is not confirmed. Panel PDF is display-only, not a device datasheet.

source_license.hardware: Schematics published — open-hardware license not verified
source_license.note: Nested codec/library licenses do not cover the vendor examples.

items.name: M5StickS3
items.summary: Compact Wi-Fi PTT prototype with built-in microphone, speaker, buttons and 250 mAh battery. LCD, not e-ink.
evidence: Reference firmware implements hold-to-talk, cancel and streamed PCM replies. Author reports LAN operation; not independently hardware-tested.
Stick $21.50 + SIM7080G $36.90 + 1NCE $14 plan / $1 SIM = $73.40 incomplete prototype subtotal.
No license found for the AI-Guru integration: obtain permission before redistribution or implement independently licensed firmware.
items.gaps: No modem, compressed audio, network switching or secure public cellular transport in inspected firmware. PCM exceeds documented modem UART throughput. Power/transients and complete enclosure unqualified; no built-in headphone path.

items.name: AtomS3R AI Chatbot Kit K147

Optional $7.50 Atomic Audio 3.5 Base A166 explicitly supports CTIA headset output/input. It replaces the base; simultaneous stacking is not verified.
items.gaps: Qualify battery/power packaging, physical PTT, real headset routing and Hermes integration. No cellular.

evidence: $49.90 in stock at audit; 3.97-inch e-paper, 750mAh battery, case and USB cable included.
Phone required for stock first setup; then works independently on Wi-Fi. Actual vendor 16kHz capture example inspected.

items.name: PaperMono-Lite
items.summary: Lowest-assembly e-ink voice-input lead: microphone, physical buttons, 1150 mAh battery and case. Buzzer only; no documented speech output.
evidence: ESP32-S3R8, 16 MB flash / 8 MB PSRAM; 3.97-inch 480×800 SSD1677 display and PDM microphone.
Manufacturer source implements microphone capture. Use the recommended OTP waveform example; custom waveforms have explicit stability/panel-life warnings.
Completed follow-up found Lite $55/out of stock on the official store; recheck before procurement.
items.gaps: Add a qualified speech/headphone output path and Hermes/PTT firmware. No ready cellular integration or tested replacement voice enclosure.

items.name: WeatherPaper / WeAct 2.9″
items.summary: Custom e-ink donor route: 296×128 black/white SPI module, ESP32-C3 weather firmware and printable body/lid. Not a voice BOM.
evidence: GxEPD2_290_BS / SSD1680 compatibility target; actual ESP32 and Raspberry Pi display example code inspected. No Pi Zero bench test.
WeatherPaper body/lid downloads verified as binary STLs; not fit-checked voice enclosures. Sketch/STL reuse license unestablished.
Exact AliExpress item matches the intended donor; selected variant, live price, stock and delivery unverified.
items.gaps: Add microphone, speech output, physical PTT, suitable MCU/audio design, power and revised enclosure. Display I/O is 3.3V; do not infer 5V GPIO tolerance.

items.spec_note: Build docs for WeatherPaper; no complete assembled voice-device specification. WeAct display module documentation is not a complete device datasheet.

items.name: Pi Zero + PiSugar Whisplay
items.summary: Strong spoken PTT architecture precedent: real hold/release capture, STT, streamed agent responses and optional TTS/playback in source. LCD, not e-ink.
evidence: Exact repository is sebastianvkl/pizero-openclaw. TTS defaults true in code despite README false. Requires remote OpenClaw gateway; not local LLM.
Current Whisplay driver entry points differ from old instructions; codec revisions, ALSA names and daemon ownership need qualification.
Whisplay $35.99 + PiSugar 3 $39.99 = $75.98 before Pi, SD, header, case and delivery. MIT-declared project omits full license file.
items.gaps: Adapt the endpoint contract to Hermes and test headphones, power and recovery. No cellular. Original clip does not independently verify spoken replies.

image.alt: Pi Zero W OpenClaw PTT handheld — @basti_vkl — source image

items.spec_note: Build docs for the Pi/Whisplay stack. Current Whisplay specs describe the HAT, not the full assembly; older project display dimensions conflict with current hardware.

Variants 33552 base, 33810 EN, 33811 Kit. Exact battery/speaker/enclosure inclusions, price and stock unresolved.
items.gaps: Source license, physical PTT/Hermes code and final audio bundle need verification; no cellular/headset established.

headline: E-ink first. Spoken replies matter.
recommendation_summary: Best e-ink pilot: Waveshare 1.54 V2 battery SKU32298, $29.89 known parts before unresolved freight/tax and qualification. M5StickS3 is the compact LCD alternative: $34.40 parts, $44.40 with M5 air only; accessory freight/tax extra. Neither is a turnkey agent.
